title: Space bound from head-position intervals
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine with $K$ work tapes, let $c$ be an initial configuration, and let $T\in\mathbb N$. Suppose that at every time $t\le T$, the head on each tape $i$ lies between integers $\mathrm{lo}(i)$ and $\mathrm{hi}(i)$, inclusive. Then the total number of distinct work-tape cells visited through time $T$ is at most $\sum_i (\mathrm{hi}(i)-\mathrm{lo}(i)+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: At every time $t\le T$, every tape head lies within its stated bounds
